title: Use current Rule 3 size in link-draft DIO example
description: Correctness review found draft-lichen-link-01 §6.1 still assumes an approximately 22-byte SCHC RPL DIO. Rule Set Version 3 defines a 40-byte fixed Rule 3 header, mandatory parent-selectable DIOs add the verbatim 3-byte Rule Version option, and link PLD also needs dispatch 0x14: canonical minimal PLD is therefore 44 bytes, not ~22. Replace the placeholder with an explicit current Rule 3+option payload and recalculate LENGTH/total together with project-LICHEN-worker6-2wi1.
